topic: Why a hotter surface can make water last longer
centralQuestion: Why can a hotter pan make a drop of water last longer?
thesis: Crossing into vapor-supported levitation can reduce direct thermal contact despite a hotter surface.
viewerPayoff: Understand why heat transfer depends on the path into the water, not temperature alone.
